about: One rule, two copies. packages/core/tests/history_before.rs and packages/cli/test/history-parity.test.ts both join real_pages and hand_made, in that order, and must give expected. The pages are real mainnet get_proposals answers read on 5 Nov 2026: a treasury that pays by Transfer, and a NEAR Business treasury whose money moves are public-to-confidential, which the rule leaves out. Prices are 1Click's list of that day.
